test_title: PYST 13: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between U and S when counted from the right of U. Only three people sit between R and C when counted from the right of C. S sits to the immediate right of C. T sits to the immediate right of A. Who sits fourth to the right of B?
solution:
A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. Only two people sit between U and S when counted from the right of U.

2. Only three people sit between R and C when counted from the right of C.

3. S sits to the immediate right of C.

4. T sits to the immediate right of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af29239f45c7e012280928962b838fb12cd73d8f1583322423bfa37e6dc74897.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/439e0cb7b022f9bdc0b3f34eed37e4b442960b24efbb78e2d3131ead25f254e8.png] 

T sits fourth to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
